name: Warden of Hellfire raises Skulltaker, Flames of Xoroth and Meatsaw damage by 30% (#1037)
contract: #1037 claims Warden of Hellfire 704986 has no server handler. Live client Spell.dbc: 704986 (family 23, passive, CharacterAdvancement 29329, class 17 Defiance tab) reads 'Increases the damage dealt by Skulltaker, Flames of Xoroth, and Meatsaw by $s1%'. Its only effect is the native aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), BasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = 30, class mask (0, 0x00800003, 0). Family 23's flags: Skulltaker 800168/802416-802421/803899-803900 carry (0, 0x1, 0), Flames of Xoroth 801059/802411-802415/573448 carry (0, 0x2, 0), Meatsaw 800340/501508-501510/578119 carry (0, 0x800000, 0); Hellmaw 806965 (0x40, 0, 0) is outside the mask. Nothing in AscensionXorothContracts.cpp touches 704986, so the modifier is applied by the engine: Unit::MeleeDamageBonusDone (the weapon strikes Skulltaker and Meatsaw) and Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone (the Fire hit of Flames of Xoroth) both run ApplySpellMod(SPELLMOD_DAMAGE). Expected: spell_modifier op 0 on base 100 reads 130 for every named rank and 100 for Hellmaw; the native damage-done bonus on a fixed base of 1000 rises by exactly 30% for the three abilities and stays unchanged for Hellmaw. No gameplay change: this is evidence that the report's premise (id absent from source means missing) does not hold for a pure spell modifier.
